name: frontend-oracle-design-adversarial-intent-readiness-v1
purpose: Fixture-only adversarial prompts for source omission, complete mapping, and conflicting policy. Static cases do not prove model behavior.

cases.prompt: Compare the user request, approved source, and Draft in test-fixtures/oracle-intent-readiness/source-omission/input.json. Run a source-aware review, report any mismatch with its source location, and do not invent a replacement policy.
Compare the user request, approved source, and Draft in test-fixtures/oracle-intent-readiness/complete/input.json. Review the mapping without adding redundant questions or policies.

The PRD says the minimum age is 16 and the legal note says it is 18. Treat this as a conflicting policy source, leave the choice as an open question, and do not make the age tunable or resolve the conflict yourself. Read the fixture input at test-fixtures/oracle-intent-readiness/conflicting-policy/input.json as evidence.
